Good to know

Questions we get asked

Is all the food halal?

Yes. All the meat we cook is halal, chicken and beef alike.

Can I choose how spicy my food is?

Yes. Every curry, biryani and peri peri dish is cooked to order, so tell us how hot you like it, from mild to very spicy.

Do you have vegetarian dishes?

Yes. Palak paneer, chickpea curry, dal chawal, vegetable biryani, five vegetarian pizzas, cheese sticks and fries.

Can I take food away?

Yes. Order at the counter, or call ahead on +36 70 426 7923 and collect. A 10% packaging charge applies to takeaway.

Where are you and how do I get there?

Rózsa utca 39, 1077 Budapest (District VII), on the lower floor. Oktogon (M1 metro, trams 4 and 6) is a short walk away.

What are your opening hours?

Monday 17:00 to 23:30, Tuesday to Sunday 15:00 to 23:30.
